terbaru.judul: Quantum cellular automata are a coarse homology theory
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that quantum cellular automata naturally form the degree-zero part of a coarse homology theory.

terbaru.judul: On the structure of categorical duality operators
terbaru.pelajaran: We systematically study categorical duality operators on spin (and anyon) chains with respect to an internal fusion category symmetry C.

terbaru.judul: Training Language Models via Neural Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose using neural cellular automata (NCA) to generate synthetic, non-linguistic data for pre-pre-training LLMs--training on synthetic-then-natural language.

terbaru.judul: Approximate QCAs in one dimension using approximate algebras
terbaru.pelajaran: We study approximate QCAs, where the locality condition is only satisfied up to a small error, as occurs for local quantum dynamics on the lattice.

terbaru.judul: Offer of a reward does not always promote trust in spatial games
terbaru.pelajaran: To fill this gap, we introduce an inter-role reward mechanism in the spatial trust game, so that an investing trustor can choose to pay an extra cost to reward a trustworthy trustee.

terbaru.judul: Algebraic Characterization of Reversible First Degree Cellular Automata over $\mathbb{Z}_d$
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this issue, this paper explores the reversibility properties of a subset of one-dimensional, $3$-neighborhood, $d$-state finite cellular automata (CAs), known as the first degree cellular automata (FDCAs) for any number of cells $(n\in \mathbb{N})$ under the null boundary condition.

terbaru.judul: Local decoder for the toric code via signal exchange
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a new local decoder for Kitaev's toric code: the 2D signal-rule, that interprets odd parity stabilizer measurements as defects, attracted to each other via the exchange of binary signals.
